webmcp.name: IC Skills
webmcp.description: Query Internet Computer skill documentation. Covers Motoko, Rust, ckBTC, Internet Identity, stable memory, HTTPS outcalls, EVM RPC, SNS, asset canisters, custom domains, and more.

descriptions.list_skills: List all available Internet Computer skill topics with their names, titles, descriptions, and categories
descriptions.get_skill: Get the full documentation for a specific IC skill by name (e.g. 'motoko', 'asset-canister', 'internet-identity')
descriptions.search_skills: Search Internet Computer skill documentation by keyword. Returns matching skills with their descriptions.

param_descriptions.get_skill.name: Skill name in lowercase-hyphenated format, e.g. 'motoko', 'ckbtc', 'https-outcalls'
param_descriptions.search_skills.query: Keyword to match against skill names, titles, descriptions, and full content
